service.name: Flamenco trio for private events
service.serviceType: Flamenco trio and dancer configuration for corporate dinners, member events and milestone parties
service.description: Dirty Flamenco, fronted by Gary Meyers: a working flamenco group with a standing repertoire of traditional palos, sold at private event scale across Denver and the Colorado mountain corridor.

video.name: Dirty Flamenco, live
video.description: Fifty-three seconds of Dirty Flamenco playing live: flamenco guitar, bass and percussion.

faqs.q: Is Dirty Flamenco traditional flamenco or Spanish guitar?
faqs.a: Traditional flamenco. The repertoire is palos, the traditional forms: bulerias, solea, alegrias, tangos. A Spanish guitar booking plays familiar songs with a Spanish flavor; a flamenco booking plays the forms themselves, and the difference is audible inside eight bars.
Yes. The quartet configuration is the trio plus a dancer, and the dancer is the set piece. Which one an evening wants depends on whether the program has space for a set piece in it.

faqs.q: Does flamenco work as dinner music, or only as a show?
faqs.a: Both, in one booking. The trio plays cocktails and dinner with a full musical range that does not depend on a dance floor, and the set piece lands where your program leaves space for it, placed against the run of show the same way a toast is placed.

Gary Meyers. This is a named act rather than a format: an existing group with a standing repertoire, booked under its own name. Any change to the lineup, the front included, is named to you in advance along with the reason.

faqs.q: What kind of events book flamenco?
faqs.a: Member and association events, corporate dinners that want one photographed moment, milestone parties, and wedding cocktail hours that want a flavor.
